decisions.contract: Generative-canvas poster projection requests wide, the variant emitted by the standard public pipeline.
behavior: The API no longer requests the non-standard poster variant for generative-canvas blocks.
The browser fixture exposes the public wide asset and the browser proof asserts its selected URL.

decisions.contract: Contributor database failures propagate to the API error boundary instead of being converted to article not-found.
behavior: Only IllegalArgumentException from projection validation is handled as an empty contributor projection.
The API integration proof makes article_contributor unavailable and asserts DataAccessException.

decisions.contract: Reader credits show contributor roles, while JSON-LD author contains AUTHOR contributors only.
behavior: The browser fixture contains AUTHOR, EDITOR and PHOTOGRAPHER contributors.
The browser proof asserts all role credits and exactly one JSON-LD author.

decisions.source: Article reader scroll and resume persistence
decisions.contract: When the viewport reaches document bottom or final navigation, progress persists the final rendered block rather than blocks[0].
behavior: The reader has no blocks[0] fallback.
At document end, the last data-block-id is selected before visible-block scanning.
The browser proof reaches document bottom and asserts the stored block ID equals the final fixture block.

decisions.contract: Reduced-motion creative opt-in is not rendered until client hydration has completed.
behavior: The opt-in button requires clientReady, reduced motion and interactiveEnabled=false.
The browser reduced-motion proof waits for hydration, then verifies opt-in creates the runtime.

decisions.source: per-block creative visibility and runtime maps
decisions.contract: Each generative canvas has independent visibility and paused/running lifecycle state.
behavior: Visibility is tracked by block ID with separate observers and a bounded visibility watch.
The browser proof uses two generative blocks and verifies independent runtime state while scrolling and hiding the document.

decisions.contract: localStorage get/set exceptions disable resume persistence without breaking article reading.
behavior: All resume localStorage reads and writes are guarded by try/catch.
The browser proof replaces localStorage with a throwing getter and asserts no page error.

targeted_proof: SSR article blocks and standard wide generative poster without JavaScript
Contributor role labels and AUTHOR-only JSON-LD
Final block progress after reaching document bottom
Independent visibility/runtime state for multiple generative canvases

failure_signatures.resolution: Production progress selection prioritizes the last block at document end; the browser proof stabilizes reduced-motion layout and waits for the true document bottom before asserting.
The changed Vue and browser test files were formatted with Prettier 3.9.6 before the passing exact-head run.
